purpose: Qualify an independent holdout for the unchanged v1 Chinese hard-linebreak warning without scoring any v1 development candidate.
design_disclosure: Design qualification observed five pre-exclusion candidates and zero independent post-exclusion candidates before this executable package was implemented.
stopping_rule: Exclude every registered v1 development identity and boundary. If any exclusion is missing, any input hash drifts, the pre-exclusion count is not five, or the post-exclusion count is not zero, fail closed. With zero independent candidates, publish NO_GO_INSUFFICIENT_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATES.
prohibited_claims: deployment or production lint integration claims
future_work_boundary: A future warning-only gate requires a separately versioned preregistration on an unseen future snapshot. This experiment defines no future candidate minimum or deployment threshold.
